pattern: て当然だ（てとうぜんだ）
purpose: Judge a result as natural or deserved under the circumstances.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Vて / い-adjectiveくて / な-adjectiveで + 当然だ
It is your first time, so mistakes are only natural.
After this much practice, feeling confident is only natural.
Of course you should return things you borrow.
formation: Vて / い-adjectiveくて / な-adjectiveで + 当然だ
restrictions: May express a natural consequence or a norm of fairness.
mistake: It can sound judgmental when applied to another person’s failure.
